differences.what: Sun shadows on the wall are crisper and better defined in B (horn and pole shadows right of the right speaker, the window-mullion shadow band); in A they are softer and mushier, so the late-sun light reads less convincingly
The cast shadows behind the vase and turntable on the wall have harder edges in B, giving clearer depth between the sideboard props and the wall
The long window shadow lines across the floor are a little sharper in B, so the parquet looks more like it is in direct sun
The upper wall's window-frame shadow edge is softer in A, a gentler gradient that is slightly more flattering but less legible
